verdict.rationale: Oneleet's docs describe an official Oneleet MCP server that assistants add directly. Connection uses an OAuth browser flow with workspace selection and no keys to paste. Alternatively, scoped service keys support MCP and agent automation. The assistant acts with the connecting member's role permissions, and every action is attributed to that account; a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific tools and actions the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of it working.
